# The twelve districts

Veyra is built as twelve great routes, one district a month. Each district keeps one part of the Art, and each is lost in the fog until its gate is passed.

| Month | District | The Art it keeps | Chapter |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Lamplighters' Quay | Foundations of Encoding (Visual Association) | Chapter One: The Lamps of the Quay |
| 2 | The Long Gallery | Memory Palace I (Memory Palace) | Chapter Two: The Walk of Portraits |
| 3 | The Hall of Faces | Names and Faces (Names and Faces) | Chapter Three: The Faces in the Stone |
| 4 | The Counting House | Number Encoding I: Major System (Number Encoding) | Chapter Four: The Ledger of Debts |
| 5 | The Clockwork Market | Number Encoding II: Number Palace (Number Encoding) | Chapter Five: The Clockmaker's Warning |
| 6 | The Tongues Bridge | Vocabulary, Pegs and Abstract Concepts (Vocabulary and Concepts) | Chapter Six: What the Bridge Remembers |
| 7 | The Scriptorium | Structured Knowledge (Structured Knowledge) | Chapter Seven: The Two Chronicles |
| 8 | The Tidal Stair | Speed and Volume (Memory Palace) | Chapter Eight: The Race of the Evening Tide |
| 9 | The Mirror Wards | Robustness and Interference (Memory Palace) | Chapter Nine: The House of False Mirrors |
| 10 | The Open Roads | Real-World Transfer (Structured Knowledge) | Chapter Ten: Beyond the Ammerhold |
| 11 | The Amphitheatre of Echoes | Integration and Competition Formats (Memory Palace) | Chapter Eleven: The Contest of Echoes |
| 12 | The Lethe Gate | Mastery, Curation and Maintenance (Structured Knowledge) | Chapter Twelve: The Night of No Moon |

## 1. Lamplighters' Quay

**The Art:** Foundations of Encoding. Recall 15 random concrete words in order after 2 minutes of study with at least 80% accuracy.

**The quest:** Relight the lamps along Lamplighters' Quay

**Once restored:** ""The pictures are back in their proper places. You have a steady hand for that sort of thing. Come by later, I'll put the rosemary on.""

## 2. The Long Gallery

**The Art:** Memory Palace I. Place and recall 20 items forward and backward in a personal palace with at least 90% accuracy; 7-day retention at least 70%.

**The quest:** Walk Calder's route through the Long Gallery

**Once restored:** ""Walked the whole Gallery without stumbling once, I see. That's all a corridor ever asks of anyone. That'll hold.""

## 3. The Hall of Faces

**The Art:** Names and Faces. Recall first names for 10 new faces after 2 minutes with at least 70% accuracy; 1-day retention at least 60%.

**The quest:** Restore the Hall of Faces and learn who walks behind the Hushed

**Once restored:** ""You matched every face to its name. I only checked my cards twice while you were doing it. Twice! My pockets feel lighter already.""

## 4. The Counting House

**The Art:** Number Encoding I: Major System. Convert 00 to 99 into personal images at under 3 seconds each with at least 90% accuracy.

**The quest:** Crack the number code of the Counting House

**Once restored:** ""Numbers are just shapes wearing different clothes, aren't they? I had a little wager on you, the Keeper. Do try to keep winning.""

## 5. The Clockwork Market

**The Art:** Number Encoding II: Number Palace. Memorize 40 digits in 5 minutes in a palace with at least 85% accuracy.

**The quest:** Restart the clocks of the Clockwork Market and read the schedule of the Tide

**Once restored:** ""Held all those long strings without dropping one. Hmph. Suppose a man could learn to count his own fares. Off my boat, then. Go on home.""

## 6. The Tongues Bridge

**The Art:** Vocabulary, Pegs and Abstract Concepts. Learn 20 foreign words and retain at least 80% after 7 days.

**The quest:** Read the inscriptions on the Tongues Bridge

**Once restored:** ""The old words stuck to you like wet clay this time. You didn't need me to translate once. I'm a tiny bit jealous, actually.""

## 7. The Scriptorium

**The Art:** Structured Knowledge. Recall 10 key facts or the 7-point outline of a talk after 1 day with at least 80% accuracy.

**The quest:** Discover the true account of the night of the great Tide

**Once restored:** ""You found the wrong line in the text before I could point to it. It hurts less when you look straight at what is broken. I wrote that down.""

## 8. The Tidal Stair

**The Art:** Speed and Volume. Memorize 30 words in a palace in 3 minutes with at least 85% accuracy.

**The quest:** Climb the Tidal Stair before the Tide

**Once restored:** ""Days go by and things feel smaller, then bigger again. You kept your place through all of it. River's the same. We're even now, Keeper.""

## 9. The Mirror Wards

**The Art:** Robustness and Interference. Recall a list correctly after studying a second, competing list, at least 80% accuracy.

**The quest:** Escape the Mirror Wards with your memories intact

**Once restored:** ""You caught the false memory before it took root. That is the hardest part, knowing which pieces of the story were really yours.""

## 10. The Open Roads

**The Art:** Real-World Transfer. Apply chosen techniques to 3 personal projects and score at least 75% on unfamiliar-format tasks.

**The quest:** Travel the Outer Roads and find out who you were

**Once restored:** ""Lists done, errands done, nothing forgotten on the road. Tomas would have liked how you kept it. He was always the tidy one.""

## 11. The Amphitheatre of Echoes

**The Art:** Integration and Competition Formats. Complete a 5-event mini-decathlon (words, numbers, faces, vocabulary, facts) with each event at least 75%.

**The quest:** Face the Grand Hush in the Rite of Echoes

**Once restored:** ""Ten thousand people watching and you never blinked. I won more on you today than the Guild makes in a month. Don't spend it all at once. I shan't.""

## 12. The Lethe Gate

**The Art:** Mastery, Curation and Maintenance. Complete the annual assessment and design a personal maintenance plan.

**The quest:** Hold the Lethe Gate through the Long Vigil

**Once restored:** ""The Tide stopped on the bridge, a yard from your feet. Did you hear a tick? Like a clock? No. Never mind. Probably it was only my own heart. I was very frightened. I did not write it down.""
